department: Doctoral Program in Computer and Communication Sciences (EDIC)

deadline.value: Main round December 1 (23:59 CET); smaller second round April 15. Year inferred.
deadline.quote: Applications must be submitted prior to December 1 (23:59 CET) in order to enroll for the following September.

gre_general.value: GRE General is optional and a missing score does not hurt.
gre_general.quote: The result of the GRE general test is optional, and the lack of a GRE score will not harm your application.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 100 if a test is needed.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 7.0 if a test is needed.

english_waiver.value: No test needed if your degree came from an institution whose main language of instruction is English.
english_waiver.quote: If you are not a native speaker of English or have not received your degree from an institution where the main language of instruction is English, you should submit the results of a recognized English-language test

supervisor.value: A central committee admits; no need to contact faculty first. Admission also needs an IC fellowship or a lab hiring offer.
supervisor.quote: This means that you do not need to contact faculty or find an advisor in order to apply.

also.quote: You are awarded an IC school fellowship or are declared eligible for direct hiring by a lab.

funding.value: All admitted students are supported financially at competitive salaries.
funding.quote: The program supports all admitted students financially at competitive salaries.

entry_route.value: A four- or five-year bachelor's or a master's with a strong background is enough.
entry_route.quote: an applicant should have a four or five-year Bachelor’s or Master’s degree

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: 55 one-year IC fellowships in 2027; other accepted applicants are hired directly by labs.
